consultation.consentLabel: I authorise the audio recording of this consultation and its processing by artificial intelligence systems, for the exclusive purpose of supporting the preparation of my clinical record. The recording is processed securely within the European Economic Area and is automatically deleted after processing. The resulting content is always reviewed and validated by the health professional before being added to my clinical file. This consent is optional: refusal does not affect, in any way, the provision of healthcare. I may withdraw this consent at any time.

clinical.consent.treatment.label: Consent to treatment
clinical.consent.treatment.body: I declare that I have been informed, clearly and understandably, about the nature, objectives and possible effects of the proposed treatment, and that I had the opportunity to ask questions and receive answers to them. I freely and knowingly consent to the proposed treatment. I may withdraw this consent at any time, without needing to give a reason and without prejudice to the care that may be provided to me.
clinical.consent.rgpd.label: Personal data processing (GDPR)
clinical.consent.rgpd.body: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) and Law no. 58/2019, I authorise the processing of my personal and health data by this clinic, for the exclusive purpose of providing healthcare, clinical and administrative management, and compliance with legal obligations. My data is kept for the period legally required for clinical records and is not shared with third parties, save for a legal obligation or services strictly necessary to the provision of care. I may exercise, at any time, the rights of access, rectification, erasure (within the legal limits applicable to health records), restriction and objection, by contacting the clinic.
